protocol.mode: private guarded virtual-window integration seam; no public activation option

workloads.purpose: bounded-window operation and repeated lifecycle sampling

protocol.gc: Three Chromium HeapProfiler.collectGarbage checkpoints before each baseline/intermediate/final sample, followed by Runtime.getHeapUsage.
protocol.dom: Deep count of document nodes including accessible open shadow roots; compared to the page baseline after each disconnect.
protocol.resourceInstrumentation: Counter-only instrumentation for custom-element scroll listeners and ResizeObserver ownership; counters retain numeric IDs only, not component references.
protocol.memoryInterpretation: Positive JavaScript heap deltas are diagnostic only. No heap threshold or leak classification is applied; require repeated retention and a reproducible ownership/reference path.
protocol.knownCaches: Where exposed by the built test component, each GC checkpoint records the entry count and configured bound for the mirrored stylesheet text cache. This is contextual evidence, not permission to classify other heap growth as a cache.
protocol.failureInjection: A one-shot throwing custom option renderer is replaced with a functioning renderer and the guarded instance must recover.
protocol.keyboard: Dispatch ArrowDown through the component input and verify the resulting active option is mounted; far-index End materialization remains covered by the dedicated Phase 4 browser regression.
protocol.staleWork: Queue lifecycle RAF, timeout, scroll update, and search notification immediately before disconnect; verify cancellation through detached and rapid reconnect windows.
